conviction_note: No decisive unpriced company number was found. A direct peer that reported after Kura last spoke (Syndax, 2026-11-02) points to Revuforj taking back NPM1 new starts (about 100 to about 150 quarter on quarter) against Kura's Q2 claim of a majority share on about 115 starts, which argues negative on the new-start and share commentary. It is offset by a crowded short (about 16% of shares, 8.6 days to cover on 2026-10-15) going into a stock that fell 25% in five sessions, most of it on the 2026-11-04 bleximenib abstract. So p_up is 49 on an absolute move of about 7%, the scaled number is near zero, and impact_sum (+0.6) has the opposite sign because the squeeze finding is sized on its own and is not netted against the share finding.
bar: Q3 2026 total revenue consensus $22.2M and EPS -$0.83 (Earnings Whispers / finviz preview 2026-11-03, https://finviz.com/news/414622/kura-oncologys-third-quarter-tests-whether-comsiftys-launch-momentum-is-built-to-last). Other estimate sources roughly agree on revenue ($22.7M-$24.1M at Benzinga/Chartmill/Tickeron) and EPS (-$0.81 to -$0.90). There is no sourced consensus for KOMZIFTI product revenue alone. It is implied at about $10-12M once collaboration revenue (about $10.4-15.4M/quarter, inside the 2026 guide of $45-55M with H1 at $24.3M) is subtracted. The trade turns on product revenue, new patient starts and share commentary, and none of these has a two-source bar, so findings on them are kept small.
positioning_check: Short interest 14,319,826 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 8.58 days to cover, 16.1% of shares outstanding (not float; float share is higher). This was 14.42M on 09-30 and 14.82M on 09-15 (https://equibles.com/stocks/kura/short-interest, read 2026-11-10). The 10-30 settlement is not yet published. No usable option chain: ATM legs are not two-sided and skew is null. Put/call OI ratio is 0.16 on 6,030 contracts, which is call-heavy. Tape: -25.0% over 5 days and -24.6% over 20 days, 8.97% above the 52-week low, 20-day realised vol 106.5%. Most of the 5-day fall came on 2026-11-04, -18% intraday to $8.10, on J&J's bleximenib ASH abstract. The crowded short plus the fresh drawdown is a squeeze setup that shrinks any negative.

findings.finding: Syndax's Q3 2026 release and call (2026-11-02), the only other approved menin inhibitor, put Revuforj new patients at about 300 (+20% QoQ) with about 50% NPM1, so about 150 NPM1 new starts. In Q2 it was 250 new patients with at least 40% NPM1, so about 100. NPM1 rose to more than 35% of $60.7M Revuforj revenue (about $21M) from more than 30% of $54.7M (about $16M). Management claimed 'dominant share of all patients starting a menin inhibitor' and more than 80% of class revenue. Against this, Kura's Q2 'majority share of NPM1 menin new starts' rested on about 115 starts. Unless KOMZIFTI Q3 starts exceed about 150 (+30% QoQ), that claim is unlikely to be repeated, and the market will hear it on the call while bleximenib is already the overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-12, +57% QoQ product revenue, 115 starts, majority-share claim): +1.51% next session. Q1 2026 (2026-05-12, revenue missed per Tickeron): -2.07%. Launch-metric surprises have moved this name about 2%, but realised vol is now about 3x that.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews (Earnings Whispers, 2026-11-03) anchor on Kura's own Q2 growth (+57%) and do not cite Syndax's NPM1 start count. If this were priced, the previews would ask about share loss in R/R NPM1 rather than sequential growth. The 2026-11-04 sell-off was attributed to bleximenib, a future competitor, not to Revuforj share in the current quarter. Caveat: the class grew, and KOMZIFTI revenue lags starts, so Q3 product revenue can still grow sequentially. The finding is on starts and share commentary, not the revenue line, and is sized net of that.
findings.independence: Q2 comparison figures are from a separate Syndax Q2 call summary (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/syndax-pharmaceuticals-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-04/), the same company and a different quarter. Kura's Q2 115-start, majority-share claim is from Kura's own release (https://www.1stoncology.com/blog/?p=112826). This is a counterparty proxy, not a Kura number.

findings.finding: J&J's ASH 2026 bleximenib abstract, released 2026-11-04, sent KURA down about 18% to $8.10 intraday, its steepest one-day fall in almost two years. Leerink called bleximenib a 'stronger-than-anticipated competitor' and a 'credible threat' to KOMZIFTI in R/R AML. Cantor called it a 'modest negative' and said Kura remains 'competitively positioned' in frontline. Management will be asked to answer this on the 2026-11-10 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Competitive and clinical data headlines are this name's large movers: -18% on 2026-11-04, -11% on 2025-02-06 on a KOMET-001 update plus a BTIG downgrade (https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/kura-oncology-drops-11-to-8-07-after-leukemia-update-btig-downgrade). Earnings prints have been about 2%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The stock is -25% in five sessions and the drawdown is this event. It is filed as context so the panel sees what the drawdown is. A rebuttal on the call (frontline positioning, KOMET-017 enrollment) or further concession could move it either way, hence the symmetric band.
findings.independence: Kura's own ASH release of the same day (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/04/3395401/35186/en/kura-oncology-and-kyowa-kirin-to-present-first-ziftomenib-flt3-inhibitor-clinical-data-at-ash-2026.html) disclosed no efficacy numbers, so there was no same-day offset.

findings.finding: Short interest was 14.32M shares at 2026-10-15, about 16% of shares outstanding and 8.58 days to cover, measured before the 25% five-day fall. Shorts sit on large gains into a print where any reassurance, such as starts at or above about 140 or a firm frontline narrative, has a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this name with comparable positioning was found. Short interest has been above 13M shares since August and the August print rose +1.51%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is not an unpriced fact in the usual sense. It is the mechanism that makes the reaction asymmetric after a 25% drawdown. If shorts had covered into the bleximenib fall, the 10-30 settlement would show it, and it is not yet published.
findings.independence: Days to cover rose from 4.79 (08-31) to 8.58 (10-15) on the same source. No second short-interest source was fetched.

findings.finding: The revenue bar ($22.2M) splits into collaboration revenue and product revenue. 2026 collaboration revenue guidance of $45-55M has been held all year, H1 booked $24.3M, and the trend is edging lower ($12.5M Q1, $11.8M Q2). So Q3 collaboration likely lands about $10.4-12M, leaving about $10-12M of KOMZIFTI product revenue needed. That is +10-30% QoQ, against Q2's +57% on +35% starts and Revuforj class TRx +13% in Q3. The total-revenue bar looks reachable, and the bar is inside what the company guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat on revenue and EPS: +1.51%. Q1 2026 revenue miss: -2.07%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a mechanical read of guidance. The small positive is that the bar asks for slower product growth than Q2 delivered, while Q2's 115 starts feed Q3 revenue through duration (management assumes about six months on therapy).
findings.independence: Q2 figures are from Kura's Q2 release (https://www.1stoncology.com/blog/?p=112826). This shares the Q2 document with finding 1's comparison but is a different line (revenue versus starts and share).

findings.finding: Funding is not a near-term overhang. Cash, equivalents and short-term investments were $519.0M at 2026-06-30 (burn about $74M per quarter in H1). Kura says this plus $180M of anticipated Kyowa Kirin collaboration payments funds the ziftomenib AML program through KOMET-017 topline in 2028. At $7.41 on about 89M shares (market cap about $660M), the equity trades near cash plus committed partner payments. A reaffirmed runway on the call removes the raise-after-sell-off fear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Runway has been reaffirmed every quarter of 2026, with reactions of -2.07% and +1.51%. No standalone history.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The sign was set after asking what the money buys: it is fully committed to a Phase 3 that is already running, with partner payments contracted, so the read is no raise and a small positive. If the market feared an equity raise at these prices, the call-heavy put/call OI of 0.16 would look different.
findings.independence: The runway reaffirmation is repeated in the 2026-11-03 preview (https://finviz.com/news/414622/kura-oncologys-third-quarter-tests-whether-comsiftys-launch-momentum-is-built-to-last), which is the same company statement.

findings.finding: CEO Troy Wilson bought about 100,000 shares in the open market on 2026-08-24 at a weighted average of about $12.39 (about $1.2M), after the Q2 print. The stock is now 40% below his price.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and stale, and it predates the bleximenib news. It is filed only as a weak management-conviction signal into the call.
findings.independence: Other insiders (Bair, Powl, Leoni) sold small amounts in August 2026 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/kura-oncology-nasdaqkura-insider-sells-31487-shares-2026-08-21/), which cuts against this.

baseline_tension: The drawdown (-25% in 5 days) already carries the competitive bear case. The Syndax NPM1-start data agrees with it and is filed small. The crowded short cuts against it, so the net is close to a coin flip with a wider-than-history move.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short shrinks a negative): Syndax share finding -1.5 to -1.2, and p_up 48 to 49.

Rule 5 (company document beats proxy): the Syndax finding stays filed as a counterparty proxy, small, and is not dropped. It also matches the 'peer printed after the company last spoke' pattern that has paid.
Rule 9 (segment net of the rest): the share finding is about starts, and revenue lags starts, so it was already sized net and nothing more changed.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the runway finding was already signed after asking what the money buys, so it is unchanged.
